other_conditions: Must be a holder of a BSKY Smart Health Card, National Food Security Act (NFSA) card, or State Food Security Scheme (SFSS) card
Family must be covered under NFSA or SFSS within Odisha
Referral to private hospitals is allowed only if the required package/procedure is not available at a government facility, there is a long waiting time, or in an emergency
benefits_summary: Provides cashless health coverage up to ₹5 lakhs per family per year, with an additional ₹5 lakhs for women members, for treatments at empaneled private hospitals.
